description: Crew events, the driver is replaced (eu07/maszyna#510): an EU07 with an AI driver waits on track 1 of Stacja1 on td.scn. 20 s after the start Crew:<vehicle> 0 0 takes the driver off, which leaves the locomotive braked; 20 s later Crew:<vehicle> 1 0 puts a new one in cab A, who gets the order to go (Shunt -1 0 from event0 of the track), releases the brakes and leaves through the exit signal.

crew: event autotest_crew_off putvalues 20 none 0 0 0 Crew:{{vehicle}} 0 0 endevent
node -1 0 autotest_crew_off_launcher eventlauncher 0 0 0 -1 none 1034 autotest_crew_off end
event autotest_crew_put putvalues 0 none 0 0 0 Crew:{{vehicle}} 1 0 endevent
event autotest_crew_on multiple 40 none autotest_crew_put autotest_crew_waits endevent
node -1 0 autotest_crew_on_launcher eventlauncher 0 0 0 -1 none 1034 autotest_crew_on end

checks.pattern: Crew: \[autotest_eu07_td_crew_swap\] an AI driver takes cab A
